speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for your patience. To begin our assessment, could you please describe the specific nature of your gait difficulties and when these ataxic symptoms first started? Additionally, what significant medical conditions have you been diagnosed with in the past?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text:
That description of appearing "drunk" suggests significant cerebellar involvement. Given your significant medical history, do you have a known diagnosis of cancer, particularly involving the spine or brainstem, or any history of autoimmune disorders?

REQUEST TEST: MRI Brain and Spine with contrast.
REQUEST IMAGES: Please provide any available MRI scans of the brain and spinal cord.
